harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: (كذلك يوحي إليك) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: He reveals to you a revelation like that revelation; the preposition phrase «من قبلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); «العزيز الحكيم» are two adjectives.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «له ما في السماوات» is resumptive; the clause «وهو العلي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one; «العظيم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The preposition phrase «بحمد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يسبِّحون»; «ألا» is for drawing attention; «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition phrase «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted second object; the clause «الله حفيظ» is a khabar (predicate); and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of «ما» that operates like laysa.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the genitive maṣdar «لتنذر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أوحينا»; the clause «لا ريب فيه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يوم الجمع»; «فريق» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is what «في الجنة» is attached to; beginning with an indefinite is permitted because the context is one of detailing; and «فريق في السعير» is like its counterpart.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «ولكن يدخل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ولو شاء الله»; the preposition phrase «في رحمته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يدخل»; the clause «والظالمون ما لهم ...» is resumptive; the clause «ما لهم من ولي» is a khabar (predicate); «ولي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the clause «فالله هو الولي» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: if they want true protectors, then Allah ...; the clause «وهو يحيي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «الله.. الولي»; «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and the preposition phrase «على كل» is attached to «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «اختلفتم» is the khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما»; His saying «ذلكم الله ربي» is a mubtadaʾ and its two khabars; and the clause «عليه توكلت» is a third khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «فاطر» is a fourth khabar (predicate); the clause «جعل» is a fifth khabar; the preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) second object; the preposition phrase «من أنفسكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أزواجا». His saying «ومن الأنعام»: the wāw is conjunctive, and the preposition phrase is attached to a ḥāl of «أزواجا»; the implied «لها» is attached to the implied second object; and the second «أزواجا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first, the implied form being: and of the livestock, for them, mates. The clause «يذرؤكم» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «جعل»; the preposition phrase «فيه» is attached to «يذرؤكم»; the clause «ليس كمثله شيء» is a sixth khabar; the kāf is redundant (zāʾida), «مثله» is the khabar of laysa, and «شيء» is its noun; and the clause «وهو السميع» is conjoined to the clause «ليس كمثله شيء».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «له مقاليد» is a seventh khabar (predicate), and likewise the clause «يبسط»; the clause «إنه بكل شيء عليم» is resumptive; and the preposition phrase «بكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The preposition phrase «من الدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شرع»; «والذي» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «ما»; «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative; the clause «كبر ما تدعوهم» is resumptive, and «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «كبر»; the clause «الله يجتبي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وما تفرقوا» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «بغيا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), governed by «تفرقوا»; the clause «ولولا كلمة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «وما تفرقوا»; «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence; the clause «سبقت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كلمة», and the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «كلمة» is omitted, its implied form being "existing"; the preposition phrase «إلى أجل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سبقت»; the preposition phrase «من بعدهم» is attached to «أورثوا»; the preposition phrase «منه» is attached to a naʿt of «شك».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لذلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادع», and the fāʾ in «فادع» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «واستقم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ادع»; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied form being: and be upright with an uprightness like the command; the preposition phrase «من كتاب» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». His saying «وأمرت»: what it is attached to is omitted, i.e.: with that; the interpreted maṣdar in the genitive «لأعدل» is attached to «أُمِرت»; the clause «الله ربنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and likewise the clause «لنا أعمالنا», the clause «لا حجة بيننا» and the clause «الله يجمع». The clause «إليه المصير» is conjoined to the clause «يجمع».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «والذين يُحاجُّون» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من بعد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحاجُّون»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «حجتهم داحضة» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; the adverb «عند» is attached to «داحضة»; and the clause «وعليهم غضب» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «حجتهم داحضة».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The preposition phrase «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الكتاب»; the clause «وما يدريك» is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «لعل الساعة قريب» is the second object of «يدريك», suspended (muʿallaq) by the hoping. «قريب» is masculine, although it is a khabar (predicate) about «الساعة», because the Arabs make «القريبة» feminine [when it refers] to kinship and do not differ over it, but when they use it for something other than kinship they make it masculine or feminine; the implied form here is: from a near place, so «القريب» was made a replacement for the place, as in {إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «يستعجل بها الذين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «قريب»; the clause «والذين آمنوا مشفقون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يستعجل»; the interpreted maṣdar «أنها الحق» stands in place of the two objects of «علم»; the clause «ويعلمون» is conjoined to the single [word] «مشفقون»; and the lām in «لفي» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The preposition phrase «بعباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لطيف»; the clause «يرزق» is a second khabar (predicate); the clause «وهو القوي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «الله لطيف»; and «العزيز» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «من» is a conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كان» is the khabar (predicate); the clause «وما له في الآخرة من نصيب» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نؤته»; «نصيب» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نصيب».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive; the clause «شرعوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شركاء»; the preposition phrase «من الدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شرعوا»; «ما» is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «ولولا كلمة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one, and the khabar (predicate) of «كلمة» is omitted, its implied form being "existing"; and the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «مشفقين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition phrase «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشفقين»; the clause «وهو واقع» is a ḥāl clause; the preposition phrase «بهم» is attached to «واقع»; the clause «والذين آمنوا» is resumptive; the clause «لهم ما يشاءون» is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين»; «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); and the clause «ذلك الفضل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «ذلك الذي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عباده», and the returning pronoun of the relative noun is omitted, i.e.: by it; «المودة» is a badal (substitute) from «أجرًا»; the preposition phrase «في القربى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المودة»; the conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «يقترف» is the khabar of the conditional «مَنْ». «شكور» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one; the preposition phrase «على الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «افترى»; «كذبا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the conditional clause is resumptive. His saying «ويمح»: the wāw is resumptive, and the wāw was omitted from the nominative verb, as in {سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ}, following its pronunciation; the clause is not conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because He, the Exalted, erases falsehood absolutely. The clause «يحق» is conjoined to the clause «يمح»; the preposition phrase «بكلماته» is attached to «يحق».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is resumptive; the clause «ويعفو» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يقبل».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «الذين» is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «ويستجيب» is resumptive; the clause «ويزيدهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يستجيب»; the clause «والكافرون لهم عذاب» is resumptive; and the clause «لهم عذاب» is a khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «ولكن ينزل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the conditional clause; the clause «إنه بعباده خبير» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «بعباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خبير»; and «بصير» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ}; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وهو الولي» is conjoined to the clause «هو الذي».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «ومن آياته خلق» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ}; «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «الأرض»; the preposition phrase «من دابة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; the clause «وهو ... قدير» is conjoined to the clause «من آياته خلق»; the preposition phrase «على جمعهم» is attached to «قدير»; «إذا» is a pure adverb, attached to the maṣdar (جمعهم); and «قدير» is the khabar (predicate) of «هو».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «ما» is a conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «من مصيبة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «ما». His saying «فبما»: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: your being afflicted is due to what your hands have earned; and the clause «ويعفو عن كثير» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «وما أنتم بمعجزين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause «ما أصابكم»; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of «ما» that operates like laysa; the clause «وما لكم من ولي» is conjoined to the clause «وما أنتم بمعجزين»; the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ولي»; «ولي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «ومن آياته الجوار» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ خَلْقُ} in verse (29); «الجوار» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ that was omitted for lightness; the preposition phrase «في البحر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الجوار»; the preposition phrase «كالأعلام» is attached to a ḥāl of «الجوار».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the fāʾ in «فيظللن» is conjunctive, and the verb is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive; «رواكد» is the khabar of «ظل»; the preposition phrase «على ظهره» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رواكد»; the preposition phrase «لكل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات»; and the clause «إن في ذلك لآيات» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «أو يوبِقْهن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يظللن»; the clause «ويعف» is conjoined to the clause «يوبقهن», and it is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the omission of the weak letter.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: His saying «ويعلم»: accusative by an implied (أن), because before it there is a conditional consequence (jazāʾ), as in: ما تصْنَعْ أصْنَعْ وأكرمَك ("Whatever you do, I will do, and [that] I honour you"); they treated the consequence like the non-affirmative. The clause «ما لهم من محيص» stands in place of the two objects of «علم», suspended (muʿallaq) by the negation; «محيص» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «ما» is a conditional noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; the preposition phrase «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». His saying «فمتاع»: the fāʾ is linking, and «متاع» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it". The clause «وما عند الله خير» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one. His saying «وما عند»: «ما» is a relative, a mubtadaʾ; the adverb «عند» is attached to the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause), and «خير» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the preposition phrase «للذين» is attached to «أبقى»; the clause «يتوكلون» is conjoined to the clause «آمنوا».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: His saying «والذين»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun; the clause «هم يغفرون» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) «يجتنبون»; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يغفرون»; and the clause «يغفرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «هم». «إذا» cannot be conditional, because the fāʾ is not joined to its apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: His saying «والذين»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the relative noun before it; the clause «وأمرهم شورى» is conjoined to the clause «استجابوا»; «بينهم» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شورى»; the clause «ينفقون» is conjoined to the nominal clause «أمرهم شورى»; and the preposition phrase «مما» is attached to «ينفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «والذين» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the relative noun before it; the clause «هم ينتصرون» is the ṣila (relative clause); «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينتصرون», and «إذا» is not conditional, because there is no fāʾ in its apodosis. The clause «هم ينتصرون» is the ṣila of the nominal relative.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: (وجزاء سيئة سيئة مثلها) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive. «مثلها» is a naʿt (adjective) of the second «سيئة»; the conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one; and the clause «إنه لا يحب» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: His saying «ولمن»: the wāw is conjunctive, the lām is of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and «مَنْ» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding conditional clause; the clause «فأولئك ما عليهم من سبيل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «ما عليهم من سبيل» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك»; «سبيل» is a mubtadaʾ and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); and the preposition phrase «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «سبيل».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The preposition phrase «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يبغون»; the clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» is resumptive; and the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ولمن صبر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «ولمن انتصر», and the lām is of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: then his reward is great; and the clause «إن ذلك لمن عزم الأمور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «من» is conditional, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; the clause «فما له من ولي» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ولي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «من بعده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ولي»; the preposition phrase «له» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «ولي»; the clause «وترى الظالمين» is resumptive; the conditional clause is parenthetical; the clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الظالمين»; «سبيل» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant; the preposition phrase «إلى مَرَدّ» is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «وتراهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَتَرَى الظَّالِمِينَ}; the clause «يُعرضون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the third-person pronoun in «تراهم»; «خاشعين» is a ḥāl of the wāw; the preposition phrase «من الذل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خاشعين»; the clause «وقال الذين» is resumptive; «الذين خسروا» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن الخاسرين»; «ألا» is a particle for drawing attention.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «وما كان لهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ ...}; «أولياء» is the noun [of kāna], and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause «ينصرونهم» is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «ينصرون»; the conditional clause is resumptive; «من» is conditional, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; the clause «فما له من سبيل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «سبيل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The interpreted maṣdar from «أنْ» and what follows it is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «لا مردَّ له» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم»; the preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأتي»; the clause «ما لكم من ملجإ» is resumptive; «ملجأ» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «يوم» is attached to the [notion of] being-settled (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn is a compensation for a clause.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «فإن أعرضوا» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حفيظا», and «حفيظا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf; «إنْ» is negative, «البلاغ» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive; the clause «وإنَّا إذا..» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the preposition phrase «منا» is attached to a ḥāl of «رحمة»; and the second conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إنَّا إذا ...».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «يخلق» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «يهب».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «ذكرانا» is a necessary (lāzima) ḥāl (circumstantial), and «عقيما» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «وما كان» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لبشر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar «أن يكلمه» is the noun of kāna; «وحيا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition phrase «من وراء» is attached to a ḥāl conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «وحيا», the implied form being: or conveying that from behind a veil. His saying «أو يرسل»: accusative by «أن» optionally implied after a conjunction preceded by a pure noun not interpreted as a verb; the implied form is: «أو أن يرسل», and «أن» with the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined to «وحيا», i.e.: by revelation or by sending; and «وحيا» is not in the sense of a verb. The clause «إنه عليّ» is resumptive, and «حكيم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «أوحينا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما كان لبشر»; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We revealed to you a revealing like that revealing; the preposition phrase «من أمرنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «روحا»; the clause «ما كنت» is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الكتاب» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «ما الكتاب» stands in place of the two objects of «درى», suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; the clause «ولكن جعلناه» is conjoined to the clause «ما كنت تدري»; «نورا» is a second object; the clause «نهدي» is a naʿt of «نورا»; the preposition phrase «من عبادنا» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مَنْ»; the clause «وإنك لتهدي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «صراط» is a badal (substitute); «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of the name of Majesty; the clause «له ما في السماوات» is the ṣila (relative clause); the preposition phrase «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila; the clause «تصير» is resumptive.
